documents.title: Bambu PLA Matte Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Matte Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Matte
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 22 ± 4 MPa, elongation 4.8 ± 1.7 %, bending modulus 1770 ± 210 MPa, bending strength 29 ± 5 MPa, impact 6.6 ± 1.1 kJ/m²) are not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1960 ± 180 MPa, Z 1670 ± 140 MPa), melt index (18.0 ± 3.2 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption rate (0.40 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 - 60 °C, 6 - 12 h), odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A01-xx", CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 190 - 230 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C for PLA*); bed temperature on the High Temperature and Textured PEI plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C for all three bed types vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃); oven drying temperature (TDS and drying wiki 50 °C vs material-table wiki 55 ℃ for PLA); HDT (PLA wiki 57°C for PLA in general vs TDS 52 °C at 1.8 MPa and 58 °C at 0.45 MPa). The product TDS values are kept.
Marketing prose proves no number: "up to 250-300 mm/s" (TDS Basic Info and store meta description) and "up to 270 mm/s*" (store page) are not stored.
Hex: the hex table writes "Lilac Purple"; the store value is "Lilac purple (11700)". Matched case-insensitively; every one of the 25 store colours has exactly one hex cell.

The store page links certificate PDFs that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/0d30076831474a6c9bfc8fe96e0df8d1.pdf), SVHC, PAHs, TSCA, POPs, CP65 and EN71-3. They are lab test reports, so safety.certifications holds only the store page's own UL GREENGUARD claim (unverified) and is not marked not_published.
The store page also links the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool, which was not cached and not read.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.
